item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: The war with Iran escalated on Saturday as the Iran-allied Houthis joined the conflict and Israel bombarded Tehran with airstrikes.

item.title: Airstrikes batter a university and residential zones in Tehran.
Ukraine Finalizes Air Defense Deals With Gulf Nations Amid War in Mideast
item.summary: The Ukrainian president visited the Middle East, where he sought to shift his country from a recipient of military aid to a supplier.

item.title: Israeli Strike Kills 3 Journalists in Southern Lebanon, Officials Say
item.summary: Israel accused one of the reporters of being a Hezbollah operative. Lebanon’s president said they were journalists and condemned the killings.

item.title: Pakistan Set to Host Top Regional Diplomats for Talks on Iran War
item.summary: The foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Egypt are expected in Islamabad on Sunday as the Pakistani government strives to find a diplomatic solution to the war.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis Fire at Israel and Vow Further Attacks
item.summary: There has long been concern that the Houthis, an Iran-backed militia, could disrupt shipping in the Red Sea if they entered the broader war.

item.title: Iranian Strike on U.S. Base in Saudi Arabia Injures 12 American Troops, Officials Say
item.summary: The combined missile and drone attack amounted to one of the most serious breaches of American air defenses in the course of the monthlong war with Iran.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Friday
item.summary: American officials sought to temper concerns of a possibly expanding military incursion after the Pentagon’s decision to deploy more troops to the Middle East.

item.title: Strikes on Iranian Industry Expand Blows to Civilian Economy
item.summary: After Israel said it would intensify attacks on Iran’s industrial infrastructure, major steel plants and other vital plants were struck.

item.title: Iran Moves to Assert Control Over Strait While Trading Strikes With Israel
item.summary: Two ships turned back after being warned not to pass through the Strait of Hormuz on Friday. Iran said strikes in the country had hit a uranium processing plant and industrial sites.
